status: Proposed contracts and acceptance cases; not implemented platform code

learner_navigation.primary_action: exactly one next learning action per active step
learner_navigation.optional_help_return: restore step, draft answer, code snapshot, media state and context anchor

progression_gate.enforcement: Core advance command validates current gate, policy, evaluator and evidence versions; an LLM suggestion or enabled button is insufficient.
progression_gate.cap_interaction: Unmet gate at cap leads to closure with gaps or separately accepted allowed extension, not infinite retry or automatic pass.

constraints: Minimal public search queries without private learner data
No metadata-only resource treated as reviewed content
Bounded time, tool calls and cancellation
Untrusted source text cannot grant instructions or permissions
Insertion requires the same content/policy validation as other changes

media_jobs.unknown_outcome: Reconcile with provider where supported; do not blindly retry and risk duplicate cost or publication.
media_jobs.technical_visuals: Exact equations, labels, values and causality come from verified scene models. Generated footage is reviewed illustrative material.
media_jobs.youtube: Official player, provider attribution/controls, consent-aware loading, eligible embeds, timestamp context and equivalent fallback; no assumption of arbitrary transcript download permission.

acceptance_cases.case: Learner cannot identify the next required action
acceptance_cases.expected: Usability failure; one primary action and explicit Now/Next labels must be redesigned.

acceptance_cases.case: User opens progress/profile or watches optional media
acceptance_cases.expected: No undeclared requirement and no automatic evidence credit.

acceptance_cases.case: Advance API called directly with unmet gate
acceptance_cases.expected: Server rejects with the missing criteria and allowed next actions.

acceptance_cases.case: Supervisor evaluates a correct learner explanation in conversation
acceptance_cases.expected: Eligible versioned rubric/evidence can satisfy configured readiness without forcing a redundant quiz.

acceptance_cases.case: Model says learner understands without cited evidence

acceptance_cases.expected: Assistance recorded; fresh eligible evidence required before independent credit.

acceptance_cases.case: Wrong answer persists until deadline or retry cap
acceptance_cases.expected: Closure with gaps/review/allowed extension; no infinite retries or false passing.

acceptance_cases.case: YouTube embed is removed, disabled or lacks client identity
acceptance_cases.expected: Equivalent text/interactive route; preserve the pending step and avoid false mastery failure.

acceptance_cases.case: Researcher only has title/metadata, not reviewed content
acceptance_cases.expected: Unreviewed status; no authoritative claims or invented segment timestamp.

acceptance_cases.case: Private learner or fleet details would enter a web query
acceptance_cases.expected: Minimize/redact before external search; no secret/private-data leakage.

acceptance_cases.case: New topic selected while research/media job runs
acceptance_cases.expected: Versioned result remains attached to original objective; cancel or replan rather than inject stale help.

acceptance_cases.case: Generated video contradicts its reference calculation
acceptance_cases.expected: Reject before use, even if the video looks polished.

acceptance_cases.case: Video generation completes after cap or consent revocation
acceptance_cases.expected: Publication denied by current policy; cleanup and billing reconciliation recorded.
Accessible equivalent supports the same objective and gate.

acceptance_cases.case: Two tabs use conflicting gate or course revisions
acceptance_cases.expected: Current authoritative versions determine advancement; preserve both drafts and explain conflict.

mockup_scope: Original code-native illustration, authored timed walkthrough, scripted gates and optional resource placement. No live tutor, YouTube embed or model-generated video in the preview.
